children: GAS ARABIAN SERVICES - SIGNS WORK UNIT RATE CONTRACT WITH SAUDI ARAMCO
GAS ARABIAN SERVICES -  CONTRACT IS BASED ON A UNIT RATE MECHANISM, AND TOTAL CONTRACT VALUE IS NOT SPECIFIED AT TIME OF SIGNING
GAS ARABIAN SERVICES - CONTRACT VALUE WILL DEPEND ON ACTUAL WORK ORDERS ISSUED AND QUANTITIES OF WORK EXECUTED
GAS ARABIAN SERVICES - CONTRACT FOR INSTALLATION OF ALL PHASES OF WELL SITES, FLOW LINES, TRUNK LINES, LATERALS, HEADERS, MANIFOLDS, TRANSFER LINES
GAS ARABIAN SERVICES - CONTRACT DURATION3 YEAR BASE DURATION WITH 24-MONTH UNILATERAL EXTENSION AT SOLE DISCRETION BY ARAMCO
GAS ARABIAN SERVICES - EXPECTS POSITIVE FINANCIAL IMPACT STARTING FROM AWARDS AND EXECUTION OF FUTURE WORK ORDERS
